periods.name: This Afternoon
periods.text: Scattered showers and thunderstorms. Partly sunny, with a high near 85. North wind around 7 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Scattered showers and thunderstorms before 2am, then patchy fog between 2am and 5am. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 66. Northeast wind 0 to 6 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

periods.name: Sunday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 84. Northeast wind 3 to 7 mph.

periods.name: Sunday Night
periods.text: Areas of fog after 1am. Mostly clear, with a low around 62. Northeast wind 0 to 5 mph.

readiness.hed: No active watches. Storm chance this afternoon, then drier Sunday.
readiness.insight: NWS has no active watches or warnings on the Fredericksburg point. This afternoon: scattered storms, high 85, 40 percent rain. Tonight 66 with storms before 2 a.m., then patchy fog. Sunday mostly sunny, 84. Labor Day starts sunny after patchy morning fog.
